What is the ranked recommendation set and the implementation phase plan?
How are commands surfaced to the advisor versus skills, and do doctor commands appear in advisor output at all today?
What does the advisor return today for the required plain-word setup and health prompts, measured live?

keyFindings.text: `.skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs` is a 116-line shim: it sets the IPC socket dir (`SPECKIT_IPC_SOCKET_DIR`, default `/tmp/system-skill-advisor`), enforces dist freshness via `checkPackageFreshness`, then `spawnSync`s `dist/runtime/skill-advisor-cli.js` — all real logic lives in the daemon-backed runtime [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs:85-109].

The advisor has exactly one front door: `.skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs` resolves `runtime/dist/runtime/skill-advisor-cli.js` inside the `system-skill-advisor` package and spawns it with the caller's arguments; a freshness preflight refuses a stale or missing dist with exit 69 (75 for `--warm-only` retryable warmups). [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs:22-23] [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs:70-83] [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs:105-109]

Command recommendations are rank-adjusted: in fusion ordering, a recommendation with `kind === 'command'` is demoted by 0.08 when the prompt does not itself contain a `/` character, so natural-language prompts do not float command bridges above skills by accident. This is the existing guard the doctor design must respect. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/fusion.ts:776-777] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/types.ts:47]

A doctor-side contract for exactly this scoring surface already exists: the explicit lane's `PHRASE_BOOST_BOUND = { min: -1.0, max: 2.0 }` is documented as the same range the doctor skill-advisor proposal validator enforces via `phrase_boost_range` in `.skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-skill-advisor-tune.yaml` — so `/doctor:skill-advisor` is already the sanctioned tuning surface for advisor phrase boosts and negative disambiguation. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/explicit.ts:107-112] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-skill-advisor-tune.yaml]

Command bridges have a drift guard: `runtime/tests/command-bridges-drift-guard.vitest.ts` compares the generated projection, the generator dump and the allow-list, which is the natural CI seam for admitting doctor bridges and asserting they stay byte-stable. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/tests/command-bridges-drift-guard.vitest.ts:1-40]

The advisor's candidate store is `runtime/database/skill-graph.sqlite`: `skill_nodes` (14 rows; families cli, deep-loop, mcp, sk-code, sk-util, system), `skill_edges`, and `skill_docs` which stores per-doc `trigger_phrases`. No command rows exist — a `WHERE source_path LIKE '%commands%'` and `%doctor%` probe returns zero [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/database/skill-graph.sqlite schema+query].

The package exposes nine stable command ids (`advisor_recommend`, `advisor_rebuild`, `advisor_status`, `advisor_validate`, `skill_graph_scan`, `skill_graph_query`, `skill_graph_status`, `skill_graph_validate`, `skill_graph_propagate_enhances`) over a resident daemon; exit taxonomy is 0/1/64/69/75, and when the daemon is unreachable the CLI answers from the local Python scorer and marks the result degraded instead of failing. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/SKILL.md:318-336]

Commands reach the scorer only through a generated bridge projection: `GENERATED_COMMAND_BRIDGES` inside `// BEGIN/END GENERATED COMMAND BRIDGES` markers in `projection.ts` (lines 153-615), exported as `COMMAND_BRIDGES` (line 617) and merged into the scoring inventory at lines 1127, 1152, 1205 via `scoringCommandBridges(COMMAND_BRIDGES)` [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/projection.ts:153-617,1127-1205].

Routing vocabulary for skills lives in each skill's `graph-metadata.json` (`intent_signals` plus `derived.trigger_phrases`); a skill's `SKILL.md` frontmatter `trigger_phrases` and `intent_signals` are not read by any runtime routing reader, and reference/asset doc frontmatter `trigger_phrases` feed routing only when `SPECKIT_ADVISOR_DOC_TRIGGERS=true`. This means a doctor-routing change cannot be expressed by editing `SKILL.md` frontmatter alone. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/SKILL.md:338] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/skill-graph/doc-frontmatter.ts:36]

`derive-command-bridges.cjs` builds that table from exactly two sources: per-skill `command-metadata.json` files (only sk-doc, sk-design, system-deep-loop ship one — 19 entries) plus a hand-maintained `allow-list.json` (8 entries) = 27 generated rows; only 5 are enabled for the TypeScript scorer (create:agent, create:manual-testing-playbook, memory-save via two ids, spec-kit) while 15 are enabled for the Python compat scorer [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs:18-40; command-bridges.generated.json counts; find command-metadata.json → 3 files].

The prompt-time hook fires on every user prompt: kill-switch check, prompt gate, one bounded CLI `advisor_recommend` call, then a model-visible `Advisor:` brief; when there is no route it emits a directives fallback status line (`Advisor: no skill matched.`, `Advisor: prompt skipped.`, `Advisor: outage (<status>)`) and never blocks the prompt. Raw prompt text is not persisted. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/hooks/skill-advisor-hook.md:33-43]

No doctor command is bridged: doctor commands live under `.skilled/commands/doctor/` (not inside a skill, so no `command-metadata.json` can pick them up) and the allow-list contains only /speckit:*, /memory:save, /prompt — doctor routing is invisible to the advisor today [SOURCE: command-bridges.generated.json entries; allow-list.json].

Scoring is a five-lane fusion (`explicit_author`, `lexical`, `graph_causal`, `derived_generated`, `semantic_shadow`) with per-variant weight multipliers (e.g. `explicit_author: 1.04`, `lexical: 1.00`, `graph_causal: 0.98`, `derived_generated: 0.98` in the default variant) and bounded constants in `weights-config.ts`. Any doctor-routing design lands inside this fusion, not beside it. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/fusion.ts:169-177] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/weights-config.ts:15-21]

A doctor-side tuning contract already exists and is wired to the scorer: `lanes/explicit.ts:108-111` comments that every `PHRASE_BOOSTS` amount must lie in [-1.0, 2.0], "the same range the doctor skill-advisor proposal validator enforces (`phrase_boost_range` in .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-skill-advisor-tune.yaml)" — `/doctor:skill-advisor` is itself the doctor that tunes advisor phrase boosts, and its invariant is "tune the routing surface, never the routing logic" [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/explicit.ts:107-113; .skilled/commands/doctor/assets/doctor-skill-advisor-tune.yaml].

The explicit-author lane already carries command syntax: a `PHRASE_BOOSTS` table maps exact command strings and phrases to skill ids and pseudo-command ids (for example `/speckit:save` → `memory:save` 1.6 / `command-memory-save` 1 / `system-spec-kit` 0.45; `/deep:research` → `system-deep-loop` 1.6 / `command-spec-kit` 0.45), and a `TOKEN_BOOSTS` table maps single tokens to skills. There is no `/doctor:*` entry in either table. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/explicit.ts:117-119]

Commands are already first-class scoring projections with `kind: 'command'`: `projection.ts` defines hand-authored `CommandBridgeProjection` entries (`command-spec-kit`, `memory:save`, `command-memory-save`, `create:agent`, `create:manual-testing-playbook`) plus a generated block of command bridges, and both the SQLite and filesystem projection loaders append the routing-enabled bridges to the skill list. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/projection.ts:75-151] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/projection.ts:1127] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/projection.ts:1205]

The explicit lane hard-boosts literal slash-command phrases into owning skills: `/deep:research` → system-deep-loop 1.6 + command-spec-kit 0.45; `/speckit:resume` → system-spec-kit 0.9 + command-spec-kit 0.75; `/speckit:save` → memory:save 1.6 — a precedent for routing a typed command name to a skill [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/explicit.ts:113-120].

The generated command inventory is produced by `runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs` from per-skill `command-metadata.json` files plus a hand-maintained `allow-list.json`; the generated summary reports 19 command-metadata entries, 8 allow-list entries, 27 generated bridges, with TypeScript-active count 5 and Python-active count 15 — most generated bridges are `routingEnabled: false`. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs:28-40] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/command-bridges.generated.json:1-10]

The hook path is skill-only in its render contract: `shouldFireAdvisor` gates prompts, `buildSkillAdvisorBriefFromCli` runs `advisor_recommend --json - --no-warm-only` within a ~2.5 s budget over stdin, and `renderAdvisorBrief` emits `Advisor:` text naming recommended *skills* — no command surface exists in the brief [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/hooks/skill-advisor-hook.md §2].

No doctor command participates in that surface today: `projection.ts` contains zero `doctor` references and zero `command-doctor-*` ids, and the only `doctor` mention in the advisor runtime source is the comment describing the tune proposal validator. `.skilled/commands/doctor/` itself carries no `command-metadata.json`, so the derive script has no input for it. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/explicit.ts:108-109] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/projection.ts]

R1 (highest value, lowest risk): build the doctor golden slice first. Add onboarding, diagnostics, control and ambiguity cases seeded from this lineage's measured envelopes to the existing routing-accuracy corpus and capture a fresh baseline; this turns every later phase into a measurable claim and reuses the existing capture script, pinned environment and bounded-delta gate. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/routing-accuracy/scorer-eval-baseline.json:1-16]

Phase 3 - Per-route diagnostics in two waves (empty phrases, then contested phrases with owner sign-off), each wave gated by the diagnostics slice and the reach probe pinning the declaredBy/phrase/wonBy triple; Phase 4 - guidance surface (fallback sentence, name formatting) plus the documentation refresh. Every phase lands with the same three structural gates and the outcome slice. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/scripts/ci-router-vocabulary-reach.cjs:24-70] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/references/scoring/validation-baselines.md:63-75]

R2: ship one onboarding umbrella command (`/doctor:setup`) as a single-route, read-only battery composed from the existing checks (`sk-code-setup-check.cjs`, `git-setup-check.cjs`, advisor status, mirror `--check`, trigger-index `--check`), so the measured empty onboarding phrases have one unambiguous destination. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:228-247] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-01.json]

R3: admit doctor routes through the supported command-bridge pipeline, generated from `_routes.yaml` so the manifest stays canonical. Per-route allow-list entries carry distinct ids (`command-doctor-git-setup`, ...) and target phrases land in `scoring-compatibility.json`; regeneration writes both TypeScript and Python projections, and the drift guard plus route-validate keep the set consistent. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs:100-130] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/derive-command-bridges.cjs:240-290]

R4: stage the phrase admission. Wave A is the measured empty phrases with zero theft risk (`disable comment hygiene gate` -> `/doctor:git hooks`, `runtime mirror drift` -> `/doctor:runtime-mirrors`, `skill budget audit` -> `/doctor:skill-advisor skill-budget`); Wave B is the contested phrases where the doctor diagnostic is the deliberate winner (`check my git hooks` family), admitted one route at a time with the ownership pin. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter6-doctor-05.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter6-doctor-02.json]

R5: render fully qualified names. Each admitted bridge's rendered `name` must be the runnable `/doctor:<command> <target>` string, because the doctor routers refuse inferred targets and the brief label is what the model and user see. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:439-447] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/git.md:13-18]

R6 (complement, not substitute): add exactly one bounded fallback sentence naming the doctor entry surface when no skill matched, deployed only after the umbrella exists so it points at something real; keep the directives block intact. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/render.ts:476-487]

R7 (maintenance): refresh the stale documentation in the same change set - the `validation-baselines.md` dated numbers and the `_routes.yaml` "Consumed by" comment once a harvester or generator consumes it - so the next reader is not misled about which mechanisms are live. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/references/scoring/validation-baselines.md:45-59] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:14-21]

Phase 1 - Measurement harness: author the doctor slice files and capture the baseline; gates are only that the capture is reproducible and the control slice records the current incumbent behavior; no runtime change, so rollback is deleting the slice. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/routing-accuracy/capture-scorer-eval-baseline.mjs]

Phase 2 - Onboarding umbrella: author the command (router markdown, presentation asset, workflow battery, route entry, catalog row and count), then admit the `command-doctor-setup` bridge and regenerate; gates: route-validate green, drift guard green, onboarding slice 9/9 top-1 to the umbrella, controls unchanged, bounded-delta rows honored; rollback removes the route and bridge entries and regenerates. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/route-validate.sh:1-30] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/README.txt:46]

All 12 measured calls exit 0 against a live advisor: `freshness: "live"`, `trustState.generation: 1033`, `confidenceThreshold: 0.8`, `uncertaintyThreshold: 0.35`. The measurement is reproducible from `events/measure-iter2-index.json`. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-index.json]

Baseline response envelope: `data.recommendations[]`, `data.ambiguous`, `effectiveThresholds` (confidenceThreshold 0.8, uncertaintyThreshold 0.35), `freshness`, `trustState`, and a `_shadow` block (`advisor-shadow-learned-weights-v1`, liveWeightsFrozen) [SOURCE: .executor-state/baseline-probes.jsonl probe 1; .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs:105-109].

The measurement preserves raw artifacts: twelve per-prompt envelopes plus an index with exit code, duration, byte size and prompt text are on disk in the lineage for later regression baselining. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-index.json]

5 of 12 natural setup/health prompts return EMPTY recommendations: "help me set up skilled", "is my repo set up right", "why is this rule not enforced", "set up the development environment", "check if my environment is healthy", "update my skills to latest" — 6 of 12 empty in fact (recount: empty = set-up-skilled, repo-set-up-right, rule-not-enforced, dev-env, env-healthy, update-skills → 6/12) [SOURCE: .executor-state/baseline-probes.jsonl].

Ten of the twelve prompts return **zero recommendations** (`recommendations: []`), so the hook would render `Advisor: no skill matched.` for them: `help me set up skilled`, `is my repo set up right`, `why is this rule not enforced`, `set up my repo correctly`, `verify my repository health`, `is the skill setup working`, `my hooks are not running`, `check if my environment is configured properly`, `something is wrong with my setup`, and `are my rules being enforced`. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-01.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-04.json]

6 of 12 natural prompts surface a SKILL instead of a doctor command: "check my git hooks" → sk-git 0.83; "my MCP server is not connecting" → mcp-code-mode 0.89 + sk-code + cli-classifier; "the skill advisor keeps recommending the wrong skill" → system-skill-advisor 0.85; "verify my speckit setup" → system-spec-kit 0.82; "install git hooks for this repo" → sk-git 0.82; "something is wrong with my setup, run diagnostics" → ambiguous with 3 weak ties (cli-external-orchestration, mcp-code-mode, system-skill-advisor, all 0.82 confidence / ~0.1 score) [SOURCE: .executor-state/baseline-probes.jsonl].

Three of the four topic-named example prompts return an empty recommendation — `help me set up skilled`, `is my repo set up right`, `why is this rule not enforced` — and only `check my git hooks` routes. The flagship onboarding phrase in the research topic has no advisor owner today. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-01.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-02.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-03.json]

`check my git hooks` routes to `sk-git` with `confidence 0.8316`, `score 0.579682`, `dominantLane: explicit_author`, `status: active` — consistent with the explicit lane's `git -> sk-git 1.0` token boost rather than any hooks or doctor vocabulary. The recommendation names the skill, not `/doctor:git` or `/doctor:git setup`. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-03.json] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/lib/scorer/lanes/explicit.ts:37]

Literal command names still miss the doctor surface entirely: "/doctor:git" → sk-git 0.83; "doctor git setup" → sk-git 0.83; "run the doctor for my repo" → ambiguous trio topped by sk-doc (a documentation skill) 0.82; "/doctor:env" → EMPTY; "doctor:skill-advisor" → system-skill-advisor 0.82 [SOURCE: .executor-state/baseline-probes.jsonl].

`help me get started with this repo` routes to `sk-doc` with `confidence 0.82`, `score 0.229089`, `dominantLane: lexical`, plus a `compiledRoute` with `action: "defer"` and no targets. A getting-started/onboarding prompt is answered with a documentation skill on a weak lexical match. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-11.json]

Net measurement: 17/17 probes surfaced zero doctor commands; the advisor cannot name a `/doctor:*` route for any phrasing today because no doctor candidate exists in its scoring inventory (consistent with iteration-1 finding f-iter001-005) [SOURCE: .executor-state/baseline-probes.jsonl; .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/scripts/command-bridges/command-bridges.generated.json].

The recommendation gate is confidence (0.8), not raw score: a `0.229089` score still surfaces at `0.82` confidence. Routing-accuracy work therefore has to consider calibration behaviour, not only phrase coverage. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-11.json]

Where skills DO answer, they are plausibly "wrong-but-defensible": sk-git for git-hook checks, system-skill-advisor for advisor misrouting — these are the anti-steal boundary cases the design must respect, not blanket overrides [SOURCE: .executor-state/baseline-probes.jsonl probes for git hooks / advisor complaints].

Every empty result is a genuine no-route outcome under a live graph — the envelopes show `freshness: "live"` and no degradation marker, so the gaps are vocabulary/ownership gaps rather than staleness or daemon failure. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-10.json]

No recommendation in the sample carries `kind: "command"`; both non-empty results are skills (`sk-git`, `sk-doc`). Combined with iteration 1, this confirms doctor commands cannot appear as candidates until something introduces them to the projection. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-03.json] [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-11.json]

Each payload carries a `_shadow` block (`advisor-shadow-learned-weights-v1`, `liveWeightsFrozen: true`) with parallel shadow scores for every emitted recommendation — a read-only learned-weights telemetry path that could inform later calibration but does not affect live routing. [SOURCE: specs/system-skill-advisor/034-doctor-command-guidance/research/lineages/deepseek-flash-max/events/measure-iter2-03.json]

`_routes.yaml` is the canonical route manifest for the routed doctor commands: it declares `/doctor:speckit` (speckit-retrieval), `/doctor:deep-loop`, six `/doctor:skill-advisor` targets, `/doctor:runtime-mirrors`, `/doctor:sk-code` setup, and three `/doctor:git` targets (hooks, standards, setup). [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:41-289]

`_routes.yaml` (schema_version 1) is the canonical doctor route manifest: a `routes` list where each entry carries `command`, `target`, `yaml`, `setup_vars`, `allowed_flags`, `mutating`, `gate3_location`, `mcp_tools`, `script_invocations`/`cli_commands`, and `trigger_phrases` — machine-readable YAML, validated by `.skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/route-validate.sh` [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:24-45].

The manifest has CI teeth: `route-validate.sh` asserts it against on-disk YAML assets, each owning router's frontmatter allowed-tools union, and internal consistency rules, with a documented dependency on python3 + PyYAML and exit codes 0/1/2/3. Any harvest change must keep this validator green. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/route-validate.sh:1-30]

Each doctor command doc carries an owner marker in an HTML comment — `<!-- skill_agent: system-skill-advisor -->`, `<!-- skill_agent: sk-git -->`, `<!-- skill_agent: system-spec-kit -->` — a latent machine-readable owner link a bridge generator could consume. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/skill-advisor.md:5] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/git.md:5] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/env.md:5]

Each route carries machine-readable fields: `command`, `target`, `yaml`, `setup_vars`, `allowed_flags`, `mutating` class, `gate3_location`, `mcp_tools`, `script_invocations` and `trigger_phrases` — a ready-made structured inventory for any advisor bridge. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:23-33]

The file's own header states the gap: "Consumed by: NOT currently harvested by either Skill Advisor implementation... The trigger_phrases field below is retained for a possible future doctor-routes harvester but is inert today" — the vocabulary was authored in anticipation of exactly this feature [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:26-33,44-45].

Route inventory: `/doctor:speckit`→speckit-retrieval; `/doctor:deep-loop`→deep-loop; `/doctor:skill-advisor`→6 targets (tune, rebuild, skill-budget, parent-skill, skill-graph-freshness, router-reach); `/doctor:runtime-mirrors`→runtime-mirrors; `/doctor:sk-code`→setup; `/doctor:git`→3 targets (hooks, standards, setup); `mcp_subroutes` (install, debug); standalone `/doctor:update` (check/align/apply/rollback/record-base/compat). 18 `trigger_phrases:` blocks in total [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:42-354].

The manifest states its own advisor status: the `trigger_phrases` are **not harvested by either Skill Advisor implementation**. Both harvesters only walk `.skilled/skills/*/{references,assets}/*.md` frontmatter (Python `_DOC_HARVEST_SUBDIRS = ("references","assets")` and the TS doc-frontmatter reader, which in this runtime is additionally gated by `SPECKIT_ADVISOR_DOC_TRIGGERS=true`), so a YAML file under `.skilled/commands/doctor/` is out of scope by both file type and root; doctor dispatch is presentation-menu/argv driven, and the field is retained "for a possible future doctor-routes harvester but is inert today". [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml:14-21]
